claims.doc: (3.3), sec3_nonreal.tex l.23-25: ψ = ψ(C) ∈ (0, π/2) is half the angle that D_C subtends at 0, sin ψ = R/|c|, and cos² ψ(C) = (C² − |ρ|²)(C² − 1)/|C² − ρ|².

So D_C ≥ 0 on {|z| ≤ 1/√λ} implies D_C > 0 on {|z| > 1/√λ}. In the w-plane, z ↦ z' is w ↦ λ/w̄."
